new: A fix for installed copies: a story that changed while the app was open is now kept for offline use too (before, it had no offline copy until the app was opened again).
Behind the scenes: a story's author can now publish a change to the test site with one command (tools/packages/publish.mjs), without a new app release.
test: On an installed copy (phone or headset), open The switch that sticks, then after its next change on the test site open it again online, go offline and reload: it should still open.
Everything else should look and behave as in the release before.
untested: The offline fix on a real headset and phone: only checked in a headless browser.
The publish command from Christiane's own computer (Windows or Mac) and her GitHub access.
